title: Farm Maps

:''See also: [[Cabin]], [[Cabin/Cabin Locations|Cabin Locations]]'' [[File:Farm Map Selection.png|thumb|right|300px|The selection area for maps at character creation.]] There are eight different '''Farm Maps''' to choose from in ''[[Stardew Valley]]''. Each map features a unique layout of [[the Farm]], offering different benefits and favoring specific [[skills]]. Only one map can be chosen when starting a new game, and cannot be changed once selected. The Standard Farm offers the most space to plant [[crops]] and raise [[animals]]. The other seven farms lack farming area, but offer special perks in comparison: : The Riverland Farm encourages [[Skills#Fishing|Fishing]]. : The Forest Farm encourages [[Skills#Foraging|Foraging]]. : The Hill-top Farm encourages [[Skills#Mining|Mining]]. : The Wilderness Farm encourages [[Skills#Combat|Combat]] (but only gives 1/3 Combat experience for it). : The Four Corners Farm offers perks from other maps and encourages [[Multiplayer]]. : The Beach Farm offers extra items and encourages [[Skills#Fishing|Fishing]] and [[Skills#Foraging|Foraging]], but discourages [[Skills#Farming|Farming]] late game. : The Meadowlands Farm encourages [[Skills#Farming|Farming]], specifically raising [[animals]], and comes with two [[Chicken|chickens]] by default. The interior of the [[farmhouse]] is decorated to match the theme of the chosen map. This includes [[furniture]], [[wallpaper]] and [[flooring]]. The exterior of the house is the same regardless of map choice. There is an abandoned building on all maps which can later be turned into the [[Greenhouse]]. Once repaired, it can be moved by visiting the [[Carpenter's Shop]] or [[Wizard's Tower]]. {{clear}} ==Map Types== {|class="wikitable" ! Name ! Map ! Description ! Associated Skill |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Standard"| [[File:Standard Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Standard Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Standard Farm thumb.png|200px|link=File:Standard Farm.png]] | * The majority of this map is [[farming]] land, ideal for [[crops]] and [[animals]]. * The biggest contiguous (tillable) rectangular area is 63 x 31 (1953) tiles. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 3427, with 235 non-tillable but buildable tiles. | [[File:Farming Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Farming|Farming]] |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Riverland"|[[File:Riverland Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Riverland Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Riverlands Farm thumb.png|200px|link=File:Riverlands Farm.png]] | * Water significantly decreases the overall farming area. * Players start with a [[Fish Smoker]]. * [[Fishing]] is viable on this farm: ** 70% of the time, players will catch town river [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in [[Pelican Town]]. ** 30% of the time, players will catch forest [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in [[Cindersap Forest]]. ** Random [[Fishing#Bubbles|Bubble Spots]] are enabled on this map, unlike for all other Farm Maps. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 1578, with 516 non-tillable but buildable tiles. * 6 bushes can be chopped down with an upgraded Axe (copper or better). | [[File:Fishing Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Fishing|Fishing]] |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Forest"|[[File:Forest Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Forest Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Forest Farm thumb.png|200px|link=File:Forest Farm.png]] | * The farm border is made of trees and foliage, just like in the [[Secret Woods]]. * Many bushes can be found on this map, including berry bushes. 16 bushes can be chopped down with an upgraded Axe (copper or better). * The western clearings spawn 8 renewable [[Large Stump]]s ([[Hardwood]]), seasonal [[Foraging|forage]] items, and unique [[Weeds#Special Weeds|Weeds]] that always drop [[Mixed Seeds]]. The possible forage items are: ** [[Spring]]: [[Dandelion]], [[Leek]], [[Morel]], and [[Wild Horseradish]] (25% chance each) ** [[Summer]]: [[Common Mushroom]], [[Grape]], [[Spice Berry]], and [[Sweet Pea]] (25% chance each) ** [[Fall]]: [[Chanterelle]], [[Common Mushroom]], [[Purple Mushroom]], and [[Red Mushroom]] (25% chance each) * When fishing: ** 5% of the time (modified by daily [[Luck]]), players will catch [[Woodskip]]. The exact formula is 0.05 + Daily [[Luck]]. This means that if the daily luck is at or below -0.05, there is no chance of catching a Woodskip. With maximum luck (0.125, only possible with the [[Special Charm]]), each cast has a 17.5% chance to hook a Woodskip. ** 45% of the rest of the time, players will catch pond and river [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in [[Cindersap Forest]]. ** Otherwise, players will catch only [[trash]]. * Additional ponds and grass areas decrease the overall farming area. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 1413, with 1490 non-tillable but buildable tiles. | [[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Foraging|Foraging]] |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Hilltop"|[[File:Hilltop Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Hill-top Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Hilltop Farm thumb.png|200px|link=File:Hilltop Farm.png]] | * The southwest hill-top spawns [[Stone]]s, [[Blacksmith|Ore]] nodes, and [[Minerals#Geodes|Geode]] nodes depending on the player's Mining level. * Each day the farm attempts to spawn several nodes. The first node has a 100% chance to spawn, and each subsequent node has 75% the chance of the last. Once one node fails that chance to spawn, no more spawn attempts are made that day. In a cleared quarry, an average of 2.4 nodes will spawn per day. For each attempt, if there is something already on the selected tile, nothing spawns. Otherwise: ** See the [[#Farm Quarry Rates|Quarry Spawn Rates table]] below. ** There is always a 15% chance to spawn an [[Artifact Spot|artifact spot]]. ** There is a chance to spawn one of the three geode nodes (Geode, Frozen Geode, Magma Geode). The geode node spawned is affected by the player's Mining level: *** If the player's Mining level is below 5, a Geode Node will always be spawned. If the player's Mining level is between 5 and 7 inclusive, there is an equal chance of spawning a Geode or Frozen Geode Node. If the player's Mining level is at least 8, there is an equal chance of spawning each. ** There is always a chance to spawn a [[Copper Ore|Copper]] node. ** If the player has at least Mining level 4, there is a chance to spawn an [[Iron Ore|Iron]] node. ** If the player has at least Mining level 7, there is a chance to spawn a [[Gold Ore|Gold]] node. ** If the player has at least Mining level 10, there is a chance to spawn an [[Iridium Ore|Iridium]] node. ** Otherwise, a [[Stone]] node is spawned. * The mining area may sometimes be blocked by a [[Large Stump]], a [[Large Log]], or a [[Boulder]], making it impossible to enter until the player has upgraded their [[Axe]] or [[Pickaxe]] to steel to be able to break it. * Additional cliffs and a stream decrease the overall farming area. * 2 bushes can be chopped down with an upgraded Axe (copper or better). * When fishing: ** 50% of the time, players will catch forest river [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in the [[Cindersap Forest]] river. ** 50% of the time, players will catch only [[trash]]. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 1648, with 930 non-tillable but buildable tiles. | [[File:Mining Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Mining|Mining]] |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Wilderness"|[[File:Wilderness Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Wilderness Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Wilderness Farm thumb.png|200px|link=File:Wilderness Farm.png]] | * [[Monsters]] spawn at night (scales with the player's Combat level). ** This map can spawn more [[Wilderness Golem]]s than other farms if they have the [[Options#Advanced Options|"spawn monsters on the farm"]] option enabled. ** Exclusive to this farm map, at Combat level 9 or higher, [[Iridium Golem]]s have a 50% chance to spawn. They have a chance to drop [[Iridium Ore]] and seeds normally obtained from [[Seed Spot]]s. * When fishing: ** 35% of the time, players will catch lake [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in [[The Mountain]] lake. ** 65% of the time, players will catch only [[trash]]. * Additional cliffs and ponds decrease the overall farming area. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 2131, with 444 non-tillable but buildable tiles. | [[File:Combat Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Combat|Combat]] |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Four Corners"|[[File:Four Corners Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Four Corners Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Four Corners Farm.png|200px|link=File:Four Corners Farm.png]] | * The farming area is split by cliffs into four distinct areas, each reminiscent of some of the other Farm Maps. * Top left: Forest Farm. This quadrant has a small grassy area containing a [[Large Stump]], and weeds here can transform into the unique ones that always drop mixed seeds, the same as on the Forest Farm. * Top right: Standard Farm. This quadrant has the most farming space. * Bottom left: This quadrant has a pond. Players have a 50% chance of catching forest river [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in the [[Cindersap Forest]] river. * Bottom right: Hill-top Farm. This quadrant contains a small quarry that spawns Rocks and [[Mining#Mining Nodes|Ore and Geode nodes]] depending on the player's Mining level. ** See the [[#Farm Quarry Rates|Quarry Spawn Rates table]] below. * Additional cliffs and ponds decrease the overall farming area. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 2952, with 562 non-tillable but buildable tiles. | [[File:Multiplayer Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Multiplayer]] |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Beach"| [[File:Beach Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Beach Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Beach Farm.png|200px]] | * Good foraging and fishing, and a lot of open space. Sometimes, [[Supply Crate|supply crates]] wash up on shore. * Both forest and beach foragables may spawn. Season-specific beach foragables can spawn year-round. * [[Crafting#Sprinklers|Sprinklers]] don't work in the sandy soil. ** There is a contiguous patch of 202 non-sandy tiles (10x20 plus 2) where sprinklers can be placed. Utilizing this area completely requires clearing the trees and [[Large Log|large logs]] (with a [[Axes|steel axe]] or better). There are 28 additional non-sandy tiles scattered around the map (mostly around ponds) which may also benefit from sprinklers. ** Intended for "seasoned players", not as a first farm. A typical strategy of increasing crop fields and crafting large quantities of [[Quality Sprinkler|quality sprinklers]] won't work on this farm. ** Large open areas can be used to build [[Barn]]s, [[Coop]]s, [[Fish Pond]]s, or [[Shed]]s. [[Grass]] can grow on sandy soil. * There are several bushes on this map, with multiple able to yield berries. 15 bushes can be chopped down with an upgraded Axe (copper or better). * When fishing: ** 15% of the time, players will catch [[Seaweed]]. ** 5.1% of the time, players will catch one of [[Oyster]], [[Coral]], [[Mussel]] or [[Cockle]]. Chances for each item are equal. ** 52.73% of the time, players will catch ocean [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in [[The Beach]]. ** 27.17% of the time, players will catch trash. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 2700, with 1928 non-tillable but buildable tiles. | [[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Foraging|Foraging]]
[[File:Fishing Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Fishing|Fishing]] |- | style="text-align:center;" id="Meadowlands"|[[File:Meadowlands Farm Map Icon.png|link=]]
Meadowlands Farm | style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Meadowlands Farm.png|200px|link=File:Meadowlands Farm.png]] | * Has a [[Grass#Blue Grass|chewy blue grass]] that [[animals]] love. * Players start with a [[Coop]] and two [[chicken]]s. The chickens are randomly named. * Instead of receiving 15 [[Parsnip Seeds]] from [[Lewis|Mayor Lewis]], the player instead receives 15 pieces of [[Hay]] from an unknown source. * When fishing from the river or a large pond: ** 40% of the time, players will catch forest pond [[fish]], ''i.e.,'' [[fish]] that are found in the [[Cindersap Forest]] pond. ** 60% of the time, players will catch trash. * The number of tillable tiles on this map is 2066, with about 2141 non-tillable but buildable tiles. | [[File:Farming Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Skills#Farming|Farming]] |} {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="Farm Quarry Rates" |+ style="white-space: nowrap; text-align: left;"|Hilltop & Four Corners Farm Quarry Spawn Rates |- !
